Global flags apply to every command and are listed once at the end.

## quire login

### `quire login`

Sign in to Quire via OAuth (loopback redirect + PKCE).

## quire logout

### `quire logout`

Delete the local credentials file. Note: this does not revoke the token server-side — to fully revoke, remove the app at https://quire.io/apps.

## quire whoami

### `quire whoami`

Show the signed-in Quire user and the orgs they belong to.

## quire user

### `quire user get <oid>`

Show one user by OID. Use `quire whoami` for the signed-in user; `quire resolve <url>` for a public-id URL.

## quire org

### `quire org list`

List organizations you belong to.

### `quire org limit <id>`

Show API rate-limit usage for an organization.

### `quire org get <id>`

Show details for one organization. <id> = OID, slug, or full URL.

### `quire org update <id>`

Update organization metadata.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--name <name>` | New name |
| `--description <text>` | New description ('-' = stdin, '@file' = file) |
| `--follower <user>` | Replace the full follower list; repeat for multiple |
| `--add-follower <user>` | Add follower; repeat for multiple |
| `--remove-follower <user>` | Remove follower; repeat for multiple |

## quire project

### `quire project list`

List projects you can see, optionally scoped to one organization.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--org <id>` | Restrict to one organization (id = OID, slug, or URL). |

### `quire project get <id>`

Show project details. <id> = OID, slug, or full URL.

### `quire project update <id>`

Update project metadata. Pass 'null' to --start / --due to clear.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--name <name>` | New name |
| `--description <text>` | New description ('-' = stdin, '@file' = file) |
| `--start <date>` | Start date or 'null' to clear |
| `--due <date>` | Due date or 'null' to clear |
| `--archive` | Archive the project |
| `--unarchive` | Unarchive the project |
| `--public` | Make the project public to the organization |
| `--private` | Make the project private |
| `--follower <user>` | Replace the full follower list; repeat for multiple |
| `--add-follower <user>` | Add follower; repeat for multiple |
| `--remove-follower <user>` | Remove follower; repeat for multiple |

### `quire project members <id>`

List members of a project. <id> = OID, slug, or URL.

### `quire project export <id>`

Export the entire project as CSV (default) or JSON. Writes to stdout unless --output is set.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--format <fmt>` | Export format: csv \| json |
| `--output <file>` | Write to this path instead of stdout (use '-' for stdout, the default) |

### `quire project approval-category add <project>`

Add an approval category to a project.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--id <id>` | Caller-supplied id (must pass Quire's isValidId; '' is the implicit Default) |
| `--name <name>` | Category name |
| `--claimer <user>` | Claimer (OID, id, or email); repeat for multiple. Omit for 'anyone'. |
| `--approver <user>` | Approver; repeat for multiple. Omit for 'anyone'. |
| `--claimers-admins-only` | Restrict claimers to admins (overrides --claimer) |
| `--approvers-admins-only` | Restrict approvers to admins (overrides --approver) |

### `quire project approval-category update <project> <category-id>`

Update an approval category. --claimers-anyone / --approvers-anyone resets to 'anyone'.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--name <name>` | New name |
| `--claimer <user>` | Replace claimer list; repeat for multiple |
| `--approver <user>` | Replace approver list; repeat for multiple |
| `--claimers-admins-only` | Restrict claimers to admins (empty list) |
| `--approvers-admins-only` | Restrict approvers to admins (empty list) |
| `--claimers-anyone` | Reset claimers to anyone (clears the list) |
| `--approvers-anyone` | Reset approvers to anyone (clears the list) |

### `quire project approval-category remove <project> <category-id>`

Remove an approval category from a project. Prompts unless --yes.

### `quire project field add <project>`

Add a custom-field definition. Use --extra for type-specific config (JSON-parsed when possible).

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--name <name>` | Field name (required) |
| `--type <type>` | Field type: text\|number\|money\|date\|duration\|select\|checkbox\|user\|task\|hyperlink\|email\|formula\|file\|lookup |
| `--hidden` | Hide the field by default |
| `--private` | Mark as private (visible only to admins) |
| `--percent` | Format numeric values as percentage |
| `--multiple` | Allow multiple values |
| `--clear-on-dup` | Clear value when a task is duplicated |
| `--extra <kv>` | key=value; repeat for type-specific config (e.g. --extra options='[{...}]') |

### `quire project field update <project> <field-name>`

Update a custom-field definition. Use --rename for renaming (or `field rename` for the dedicated command).

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--type <type>` | New type |
| `--hidden` |  |
| `--private` |  |
| `--percent` |  |
| `--multiple` |  |
| `--clear-on-dup` |  |
| `--extra <kv>` | key=value; repeat for type-specific config |

### `quire project field rename <project> <field-name>`

Rename a custom-field definition.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--new-name <new-name>` | New field name |

### `quire project field move <project> <field-name>`

Reorder a custom-field definition. --before <field-name> places it just before that field; --to-end puts it at the end.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--before <field-name>` | Move just before this field |
| `--to-end` | Move to the end of the field list |

### `quire project field remove <project> <field-name>`

Remove a custom-field definition. Prompts unless --yes.

## quire task

### `quire task list <project>`

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--limit <n>` | Page size; positive integer or 'no' for unlimited. |
| `--cursor <token>` | Cursor token from a previous page (Apr 2026 cursor pagination). |

### `quire task get <id>`

Show task details. <id> = OID, project-slug/#408, or full URL.

### `quire task tree <id>`

Render the recursive subtree under a task.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--depth <n>` | Tree depth; positive integer (default 3) or 'full'. |

### `quire task search <query>`

Search tasks by text. Scope with --project, --org, or --folder (one is required).

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--project <id>` | Search within one project. |
| `--org <id>` | Search within one organization (no project required). |
| `--folder <id>` | Search within one folder OID. |
| `--mine` | Restrict to tasks assigned to me. |
| `--assignee <user>` | Filter by assignee (OID, id, or email). |
| `--follower <user>` | Filter by follower (OID, id, or email). |
| `--tag <tag>` | Filter by tag. |
| `--status <status>` | Filter: 'active' / 'completed' / numeric 0-100. |
| `--priority <priority>` | Filter: low / medium / high / urgent or -1 / 0 / 1 / 2. |
| `--limit <n>` | Page size. |

### `quire task subtasks <id>`

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--limit <n>` | Page size. |
| `--cursor <token>` | Cursor from a previous page. |

### `quire task comments <id>`

List a task's comments.

### `quire task create <project>`

Create a task in a project. Combine with --parent or --sibling+--position to nest / position.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--name <name>` | Task name (required) |
| `--description <text>` | Task description |
| `--priority <priority>` | low\|medium\|high\|urgent |
| `--due <date>` | Due date (YYYY-MM-DD or ISO 8601) |
| `--start <date>` | Start date |
| `--assignee <user>` | Assignee (OID, id, or email); repeat for multiple |
| `--follower <user>` | Follower (OID, ID, email, 'me', 'app', or 'inherit'); repeat for multiple |
| `--tag <tag>` | Tag; repeat for multiple |
| `--parent <id>` | Create as a subtask of this parent task |
| `--sibling <id>` | Create relative to this sibling task (use with --position) |
| `--position <pos>` | Used with --sibling: 'before' or 'after' |
| `--recurrence-freq <freq>` | Recurrence: daily \| weekly \| monthly \| yearly |
| `--recurrence-interval <n>` | Recurrence: positive integer (every N freq-units) |
| `--recurrence-byweekday <days>` | Recurrence: comma-separated day numbers 0-6 (0=Sun) |
| `--recurrence-until <date>` | Recurrence: ISO 8601 / YYYY-MM-DD end date |

### `quire task update <id>`

Update task fields. Pass any subset of flags.

| `--name <name>` |  |
| `--description <text>` |  |

### `quire task complete <id>`

Mark a task complete.

### `quire task uncomplete <id>`

Re-open a completed task (sets status to 0 / active).

### `quire task move <id>`

Re-parent a task within the same project.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--to <id>` | New parent task ID, or 'root' to move under the project root |
| `--position <pos>` | 'parent', 'before', or 'after' |

### `quire task transfer <id>`

Transfer a task to a different project (cross-project move).

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--to <project>` | Target project (OID, slug, or URL) |
| `--task <id>` | Anchor task within the target project (use with --position) |
| `--position <pos>` | 'parent', 'before', or 'after' relative to --task |
| `--keep-tags` | Preserve tags during transfer |
| `--keep-status` | Preserve status during transfer |
| `--keep-custom-fields` | Preserve custom fields during transfer |
| `--invite` | Invite the assignees to the target project |

### `quire task dates <id>`

Set or clear task start / due dates. Pass 'null' to clear a date.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--start <date>` | Start date or 'null' to clear |
| `--due <date>` | Due date or 'null' to clear |

### `quire task peekaboo <id>`

Hide (peekaboo) a task. --reshow-at <ISO 8601> sets a re-show time; --show un-hides.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--reshow-at <iso8601>` | Reshow at this ISO 8601 timestamp (omit to hide indefinitely) |
| `--show` | Un-hide the task instead of hiding it |

### `quire task delete <id>`

Delete a task. Prompts for confirmation unless --yes is set.

### `quire task undo-remove <id>`

Restore a deleted task. Requires the task OID — slug/#N forms cannot address deleted tasks.

### `quire task attach <id> <file>`

Attach a file to a task. <file> = path on disk, or '-' to read bytes from stdin (then --filename is required).

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--filename <name>` | Server-side filename (defaults to the basename of <file>; required when <file> = '-') |
| `--content-type <mime>` | Content-Type header (defaults to extension-based guess; falls back to application/octet-stream) |

### `quire task bulk-create <project>`

Create many tasks atomically (max 300/call). --from-file accepts a JSON array of task objects; '-' reads stdin.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--from-file <file>` | JSON array of task objects (or '-' for stdin) |
| `--dry-run` | Validate the batch server-side without persisting; response mirrors the real call. |

### `quire task bulk-subtasks <parent>`

Create many subtasks under one parent atomically (max 300/call). <parent> = OID, slug/#N, or URL.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--from-file <file>` | JSON array of task objects (or '-' for stdin) |
| `--position <pos>` | Insert position: parent \| before \| after (default: server's submit-order) |
| `--dry-run` | Validate the batch server-side without persisting; response mirrors the real call. |

### `quire task bulk-update <project>`

Update many tasks atomically. Each item must include `oid`.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--from-file <file>` | JSON array of update objects (or '-' for stdin) |
| `--dry-run` | Validate the batch server-side without persisting; response mirrors the real call. |

### `quire task bulk-delete <project>`

Delete many tasks. Refs are OIDs or numeric IDs; one per line, blank / '#'-comment lines OK, JSON array also accepted.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--from-file <file>` | Ref list (one per line) or JSON array (or '-' for stdin) |
| `--dry-run` | Validate the batch server-side without persisting; tasks survive and the confirmation prompt is skipped. |

### `quire task bulk-move <project>`

Re-parent many tasks within the same project.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--from-file <file>` | Ref list (one per line) or JSON array (or '-' for stdin) |
| `--to <id>` | New parent task OID, or 'root' to move under the project root |
| `--position <pos>` | 'parent', 'before', or 'after' |
| `--dry-run` | Validate the batch server-side without persisting; response mirrors the real call. |

### `quire task bulk-transfer <project>`

Transfer many tasks from <project> to another project.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--from-file <file>` | Ref list (one per line) or JSON array (or '-' for stdin) |
| `--to <project>` | Target project (OID, slug, or URL) |
| `--task <id>` | Anchor task in the target project |
| `--position <pos>` | 'parent', 'before', or 'after' |
| `--keep-tags` | Preserve tags during transfer |
| `--keep-status` | Preserve status during transfer |
| `--keep-custom-fields` | Preserve custom fields during transfer |
| `--invite` | Invite the assignees to the target project |
| `--dry-run` | Validate the batch server-side without persisting; response mirrors the real call. |

### `quire task bulk-approve <project>`

Apply an approval state to many tasks at once.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--from-file <file>` | Ref list (one per line) or JSON array (or '-' for stdin) |
| `--state <state>` | 'request' \| 'approve' \| 'reject' \| 'change' |
| `--category <id>` | Approval category (only used when --state request) |
| `--dry-run` | Validate the batch server-side without persisting; response mirrors the real call. |

### `quire task approve <id>`

Set a task's approval state. Optionally post a companion comment.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--state <state>` | request \| approve \| reject \| change |
| `--category <id>` | Approval category id (only meaningful for --state request) |
| `--comment <text>` | Post a companion comment with the approval; '-' for stdin or '@file' for a file. Server prefixes with **<stream>: <status>**. |
| `--comment-pinned` | Pin the companion comment (requires --comment). |
| `--comment-as-user <user>` | Post the companion comment as another user OID/id/email (requires --comment). |

### `quire task revoke-approval <id>`

Revoke any approval state on a task.

### `quire task timelog add <task-id>`

Add a timelog entry to a task.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--start <iso8601>` | Start timestamp (ISO 8601) |
| `--end <iso8601>` | End timestamp (ISO 8601) |
| `--user <user>` | Log against another user (OID, id, or email; default: self) |
| `--billable` | Mark as billable |
| `--note <text>` | Optional note |

### `quire task timelog update <task-id>`

Update a timelog entry. Use --start / --end / --user to identify the row; --new-* and --note / --billable to change it.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--start <iso8601>` | Existing start timestamp |
| `--end <iso8601>` | Existing end timestamp |
| `--user <user>` | User on the existing row (when not self) |
| `--new-start <iso8601>` | Replace the start timestamp |
| `--new-end <iso8601>` | Replace the end timestamp |
| `--new-user <user>` | Replace the user |
| `--billable` | Mark billable |
| `--no-billable` | Clear the billable flag |
| `--note <text>` | Replace the note (pass an empty string to clear) |

### `quire task timelog remove <task-id>`

Remove a timelog entry. Identify the row via --start / --end (and --user if not self).

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--start <iso8601>` | Existing start timestamp |
| `--end <iso8601>` | Existing end timestamp |
| `--user <user>` | User on the row (when not self) |

### `quire task formula <project>`

Evaluate formula custom fields for every task in a project.

## quire mine

### `quire mine`

List tasks assigned to me. Scope with --project, --inbox, --org, or --all-orgs.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--project <id>` | Restrict to one project. |
| `--inbox` | Restrict to my private Inbox. |
| `--org <id>` | Restrict to one organization. |
| `--all-orgs` | Fan out across every organization you belong to (includes Inbox; pass --skip-inbox to exclude). |
| `--skip-inbox` | With --all-orgs, exclude the private Inbox from the fan-out. |
| `--limit <n>` | Page size (positive integer or 'no' for unlimited). |

### `quire sublist list <project>`

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--name <name>` | New name |
| `--description <text>` | New description ('-' = stdin, '@file' = file) |
| `--archive` | Archive the chat |
| `--unarchive` | Unarchive the chat |
| `--follower <user>` | Replace the full follower list; repeat for multiple |
| `--add-follower <user>` | Add follower; repeat for multiple |
| `--remove-follower <user>` | Remove follower; repeat for multiple |

### `quire chat delete <oid>`

Delete a chat. Prompts unless --yes.

### `quire chat undo-remove <oid>`

Restore a deleted chat.

### `quire chat comment add <chat-id>`

Post a comment to a chat. --text accepts '-' (stdin) or '@file'.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--text <text>` | Comment text; '-' for stdin or '@file' to read from disk. |
| `--pin` | Pin the comment after creating it |

## quire doc

### `quire doc list <project>`

List documents in a project. <project> = OID, slug, or URL.

### `quire doc get <id>`

Show document details. <id> = OID, project-slug/<doc-id>, or URL.

### `quire doc create <project>`

Create a document in a project. --description accepts '-' (stdin) or '@file'.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--name <name>` | Document name (required) |
| `--description <text>` | Document description; '-' for stdin or '@file' for a file |
| `--follower <user>` | Follower (OID, ID, or email); repeat for multiple. Project-owned docs only. |
| `--member <user>` | Restrict visibility to this user (OID, ID, email, or 'me'); repeat for multiple. Omit for every member of the owner. Cannot be changed after creation. |
| `--members-admins-only` | Restrict visibility to the owner's admins (empty member list). Cannot be changed after creation. |

### `quire doc update <oid>`

Update a document.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--name <name>` | New name |
| `--description <text>` | New description ('-' for stdin, '@file' for a file) |
| `--archive` | Archive the document |
| `--unarchive` | Unarchive the document |
| `--follower <user>` | Replace the full follower list; repeat for multiple. Project-owned docs only. |
| `--add-follower <user>` | Add follower; repeat for multiple. Project-owned docs only. |
| `--remove-follower <user>` | Remove follower; repeat for multiple. Project-owned docs only. |

### `quire doc delete <oid>`

Delete a document. Prompts unless --yes.

### `quire doc undo-remove <oid>`

Restore a deleted document.

| `--member <user>` | Restrict visibility to this user (OID, ID, email, or 'me'); repeat for multiple. Omit for every member of the owner. Cannot be changed after creation. |
| `--members-admins-only` | Restrict visibility to the owner's admins (empty member list). Cannot be changed after creation. |

Update an insight.

|---|---|
| `--name <name>` |  |
| `--description <text>` | '-' = stdin, '@file' = file |

| `--image <url>` |  |
| `--archive` | Archive the insight |
| `--unarchive` | Unarchive the insight |

### `quire insight delete <oid>`

Delete an insight. Prompts unless --yes.

### `quire insight undo-remove <oid>`

| `--private` |  |

| `--multiple` |  |

## quire dashboard

### `quire dashboard list <owner>`

List dashboards on an owner. <owner> = OID, slug, or URL (projects / orgs); folders need an OID.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--owner-type <type>` | Owner type: project \| organization \| folder \| smart-folder (default: project) |

### `quire dashboard get <id>`

Show dashboard details. <id> = OID or "owner-id/<dashboard-id>" (owner id per --owner-type).

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--owner-type <type>` | Owner type for the slug form: project \| organization \| folder \| smart-folder (default: project) |

### `quire dashboard create <owner>`

Create a dashboard on an owner (project by default).

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--name <name>` | Dashboard name (required) |
| `--owner-type <type>` | Owner type: project \| organization \| folder \| smart-folder (default: project) |
| `--id <id>` | Caller-supplied id (must pass Quire's isValidId) |
| `--description <text>` | Description; '-' for stdin or '@file' for a file |
| `--icon-color <color>` | Color: name like 'red'/'blue' or 2-digit code |
| `--image <url>` | Icon image URL |
| `--partner <oid>` | Partner OID, if this is a partner dashboard |
| `--start <date>` | Start date |
| `--due <date>` | Due date |
| `--member <user>` | Restrict visibility to this user (OID, ID, email, or 'me'); repeat for multiple. Omit for every member of the owner. Cannot be changed after creation. |
| `--members-admins-only` | Restrict visibility to the owner's admins (empty member list). Cannot be changed after creation. |

### `quire dashboard update <oid>`

Update a dashboard. Pass 'null' to --start / --due to clear the date.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--id <id>` | New id |
| `--name <name>` | New name |
| `--description <text>` | New description ('-' = stdin, '@file' = file) |
| `--icon-color <color>` |  |
| `--image <url>` |  |
| `--start <date>` | Start date or 'null' to clear |
| `--due <date>` | Due date or 'null' to clear |
| `--archive` | Archive the dashboard |
| `--unarchive` | Unarchive the dashboard |

### `quire dashboard delete <oid>`

Delete a dashboard. Prompts unless --yes.

### `quire dashboard undo-remove <oid>`

Restore a deleted dashboard.

## quire reminder

### `quire reminder list <owner>`

List reminders on an owner. A project's list includes the reminders on its tasks — pass --owner-type task to narrow to one task. Use '-' as <owner> for your own Inbox.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--owner-type <type>` | Owner type: project \| organization \| folder \| smart-folder \| task (default: project) |
| `--limit <n>` | Page size; 1-1000 or 'no' for every reminder in one call. |
| `--cursor <token>` | Cursor from the last item of a previous page. |

### `quire reminder get <oid>`

Show one reminder.

### `quire reminder create <owner>`

Create a reminder. --when is required unless the reminder is on a task that already has a start or due date — that task's schedule supplies the fire time, and passing --when / --recurrence-* then is rejected with 400.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--owner-type <type>` | Owner type: project \| organization \| folder \| smart-folder \| task (default: project) |
| `--when <iso8601>` | Fire time (UTC, ISO 8601). A bare YYYY-MM-DD means midnight UTC — there is no all-day reminder. |
| `--lead <spec>` | Notify this far ahead: '<n>m' minutes, '<n>d' days, or '<n>d@HH:mm'; repeat for multiple (max 30). Omit for one notification at the fire time. |
| `--name <text>` | Message shown instead of the default (Markdown); '-' for stdin or '@file' for a file |
| `--partner <oid>` | Share with an external team. Project reminders only; cannot be combined with --member. |
| `--recurrence-freq <freq>` | Recurrence: daily \| weekly \| monthly \| yearly |
| `--recurrence-interval <n>` | Recurrence: positive integer (every N freq-units) |
| `--recurrence-byweekday <days>` | Recurrence: comma-separated day numbers 0-6 (0=Sun) |
| `--recurrence-until <date>` | Recurrence: ISO 8601 / YYYY-MM-DD end date |
| `--member <user>` | Restrict visibility to this user (OID, ID, email, or 'me'); repeat for multiple. Omit for every member of the owner. Cannot be changed after creation. |
| `--members-admins-only` | Restrict visibility to the owner's admins (empty member list). Cannot be changed after creation. |

### `quire reminder update <oid>`

Update a reminder. Only --when / --recurrence-* / --lead / --name can be changed — members and partner are create-only, so recreate the reminder to change who can see it.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--when <iso8601>` | New fire time, or 'null' to clear it |
| `--lead <spec>` | Replace the whole lead list; repeat for multiple (max 30) |
| `--name <text>` | New message, or 'null' to fall back to the default; '-' for stdin or '@file' for a file |
| `--clear-recurrence` | Stop the reminder repeating |
| `--recurrence-freq <freq>` | Recurrence: daily \| weekly \| monthly \| yearly |
| `--recurrence-interval <n>` | Recurrence: positive integer (every N freq-units) |
| `--recurrence-byweekday <days>` | Recurrence: comma-separated day numbers 0-6 (0=Sun) |
| `--recurrence-until <date>` | Recurrence: ISO 8601 / YYYY-MM-DD end date |

### `quire reminder delete <oid>`

Delete a reminder permanently. Prompts unless --yes.

## quire resolve

### `quire resolve <url>`

Resolve a Quire URL into the typed resource (organization / project / task / chat / document / user).

## quire colors

### `quire colors`

List Quire's 48-slot icon-color palette (codes, hex, friendly names).

## quire notify

### `quire notify`

Send an in-app notification. Defaults to self; use --recipient or --all to fan out. Requires the `share` OAuth scope.

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--message <text>` | Notification text ('-' = stdin, '@file' = file) |
| `--url <url>` | Optional link the notification opens when clicked |
| `--recipient <user>` | User OID, ID, or email; repeat for multiple recipients. Omit to notify yourself. |
| `--all` | Broadcast to every user visible to the app (sends recipients: ["*"]). Cannot be combined with --recipient. |

## quire undo

### `quire undo <kind> <oid>`

Restore a deleted resource. <kind> = task \| chat \| comment \| dashboard \| document \| insight \| sublist. Mirrors the per-resource `undo-remove` subcommands.

---

## Global flags

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `-v, --version` | Print the CLI version |
| `--verbose` | Enable verbose (debug) logging on stderr |
| `--json` | Emit raw API JSON (no human formatting) |
| `-q, --quiet` | Print only IDs (one per line) — designed for xargs pipelines |
| `--color-mode <mode>` | Color output mode: always\|never\|auto |
| `--profile <name>` | Use a named credential profile (default: $QUIRE_PROFILE or 'default') |
| `--yes` | Auto-confirm destructive prompts (required for non-interactive mutating commands) |
| `--no-truncate` | Disable per-cell truncation in human-readable tables |
